artifact_observations.location: Handwritten entries in the calendar grid
artifact_observations.reasoning: The handwritten numbers and letters exhibit slight AI-style inconsistency; some characters are malformed or float slightly above the grid lines rather than sitting firmly on them.
The geometry of the metal rings is slightly irregular. The top ring's clasp mechanism appears fused or indistinct, lacking the sharp mechanical definition of a real binder clip.

artifact_observations.location: Grid lines on the right page
artifact_observations.reasoning: The vertical grid lines show minor waviness and inconsistent spacing, suggesting a slight failure in maintaining rigid geometric perspective across the page surface.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a binder/ring-binder and not just loose papers.
To rigorously audit the legibility and correctness of the printed headers and handwritten numbers, which are prone to AI gibberish.
To verify the 3D structural integrity of the metal rings and ensure they properly pierce/hold the paper holes without melting.
To detect subtle texture anomalies in the paper grain and lighting consistency.

focus_areas: Legibility and structure of handwritten text
Mechanical correctness of the metal ring binder
Geometric straightness of the printed grid lines
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'handwritten' numbers. AI often struggles to render consistent handwriting that aligns perfectly with printed grids. Check if the numbers look like distinct characters or melted blobs. Also, inspect the metal rings for realistic metallic reflection and mechanical joints.
